text:
Dr.Jeremy Barnet
Emergency Register 
Duty Maraubra Hospital 
Liked Rd Marouble
1/6/2011
Dear Dr Barent,
Re:Mr John Elvin,aged 49 years
Thank you for seeing Mr Elvin,who has been demonstrating symptoms and signs consistent with anterior acute myocardial infarction and  exacerbating asthma. Your management would be valued.
On today’s review, Mr Elvin presented at the medical center complaining of crushing chest pain, which was not relieved by arginine ,  along with worsening asthma. The ECG revealed mild st elevation in the anterior lead , and the oxygen saturation was of 86% . Mild bi lateral crackles,  moderate wheeze and s3 sound were detected on examination. As a result, g2 15 L via non -ve breather, gtn patch, iv morphine 5mg , ipratropium 500mg ,and frusemide was given .
From 5/5/2011 to 26/5/2011 , Mr Elvin attended the clinic on different occasions complaining of central chest pain , and he stated worsening asthma. At that time, some investigations were ordered.  The investigations were normal apart from increasing cholesterol levels and chest pain at a high exercise level. Consequently, ischemic heart disease along with angina was provisionally diagnosed. Lipitor,nitrate,Aspirin, and salbutamol were prescribed. 
Mr,Elvin is asmoker,he smokes one pack per day. Additionally, he is alcohol dependent as he drinks ten standard cups. Please be noted , iadvised that he stop drinking , but he refused .
Given these finding, it would be appreciated if you assess his condition as you see appropriate.
Yours sincerely, 
Doctor
